summary: RIYADH — A cruise missile launched by the terrorist Houthi militia toward the Riyadh region was intercepted and destroyed. This was revealed by Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, spokesperson of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen. A UAV was also intercepted and destroyed in the Riyadh region, he said.
